en: Shuichi, how can I help you?
Help me?

Give me any command.
I will do anything for you.

Ah, I don't really have anything
to ask of you at the moment.
Why did you talk to me then?

Well, I was thinking that we could spend
some time together. Is that alright?

No, not at all. If that is what you wish for,
then I will wait by your side forever.

So, please do not hesitate and
request anything.

Ah, it's not that I want you to wait on me.
I just wanted to be with you awhile.

That is a rather vague request.
What do you wish for me to do?

I already told you, I don't "wish"
for you to do anything.
Why did you call for me then?

Alright, how about this?
Let's talk about something.

Would you like me to serve you by
keeping you company?
Serve...?
Is that not what you wished for?

<CLT=cltMIND>No, that isn't quite it...
What should I say?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi is a maid, perhaps that's
why she's so insistent about this.

<CLT=cltMIND>But at this rate, I'm gonna suffocate.
Kirumi is being too serious...
...Hey, Kirumi.

Didn't you chat with your classmates
during lunch breaks or after school?

I had, somewhat.
Why do you ask?

Well, because I want to spend
time with you in that way.

For example, perhaps we could...drink
some tea in the dining hall?

Yes, that is fine.
Then, let us go to the dining hall.
<CLT=cltMIND>Good, she seems to understand.

Shuichi, what would you like to drink?
Tea or coffee?
Ah...tea, I suppose.

Understood.
I will go and prepare it. Please wait.
Ah, wait, Kirumi!

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, too late. She's already
in the kitchen.

<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't mean to make her
prepare tea all by herself...
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...

My apologies for making you wait.
It is done.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi returned, pushing a cart.
On that cart was...

Whoa!
What is all this!?
It is your afternoon tea.

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, I can see that, but I've never
seen something so extravagant!

<CLT=cltMIND>There were delectable sandwiches,
cakes, and scones lined up on the cart...

<CLT=cltMIND>The tea smelled so wonderful, it put all
the other tea I had ever had to shame.

<CLT=cltMIND>She prepared all that in just minutes...
Is this the power of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltMIND>?
Shuichi, please sit here.

Ah, yes.
Thank you...

<CLT=cltMIND>I sat down but noticed Kirumi standing
still, with perfect posture as always.
Kirumi? Aren't you going to sit?
But if I sit as well, then I cannot serve you.

I don't want you to serve me.
Come and sit with me...

I prepared this just for you.
So, please.
But...

Shuichi, you commanded me to prepare
you tea.

And I intend to complete any requests
given. Please enjoy this tea.
O-Okay...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kirumi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi waited on me hand and foot,
and I returned to my room.

<CLT=cltMIND>The tea, the sandwiches, the scones,
the cakes... They were all excellent.
